items.title: Anthropic pledges 5% of equity to new public benefit fund, +2% per 50% valuation gain
items.summary: Anthropic will commit 5% of its shares to the newly created Anthropic Public Benefit Fund LLC, a wholly-owned entity, with the board able to add 2% more for every 50% increase in company value. Combined with the founders' earlier giving pledges and employee matching, roughly 20% of shares are now dedicated to public-benefit purposes; the money cannot be used for lobbying or political donations. Musk replied on X suggesting the shares be given 'directly to the public'.

items.title: OpenAI confirms in-house humanoid robot; Altman says 'We will', demo in 2027
items.summary: Asked on the Sources podcast whether OpenAI would build a humanoid robot, Altman answered 'We will' — reasoning that the world is very much designed for people. He stressed the hard problem is the 'brain' that makes the robot work, not the body. In a Fortune interview he gave a 2027 demo timeline but said commercial use is still years away. OpenAI is hiring for 27 robotics roles covering custom actuators and manufacturing supply chain.

items.title: AI infrastructure credit alarm: CoreWeave CDS spreads break 1,000 bps into 'distressed' territory
items.summary: CoreWeave's stock fell nearly 25% in a week, bond yields approached 15%–16%, and five-year CDS spreads blew past 1,000 bps into 'distressed' territory, implying roughly a 63% chance of default over five years. CDS spreads for Oracle and SoftBank also hit records. Analysts say only about a third of planned US data centers look credible, with 47+ large projects delayed, withdrawn or rejected this year.

items.title: SoftBank's 10GW 'Flagship' Ohio AI data center enters formal PJM interconnection study
items.summary: PJM filed a study agreement with FERC to formally assess SoftBank's roughly 10GW 'Flagship' AI data center complex in Pike County, Ohio: SB Energy will build the power and transmission assets (including ~10.2GW of new gas-fired generation, phased through 2032), with local ratepayer-protection provisions. Next steps hinge on PJM's study conclusions and the grid-connection approval timeline.

items.title: vLLM v0.32.0 released: new /v1/systemone structured-decision endpoint
items.summary: vLLM v0.32.0 shipped (814 commits, 363 contributors) with a new POST /v1/systemone endpoint for structured decisions: choice, boolean and scoring questions are evaluated directly inside the inference engine, avoiding a second HTTP hop for routing and keeping the KV cache intact. Also new: NVFP4 low-precision KV, three model-inference security fixes and CORS hardening.

items.title: DeepSeek V4.1 Flash shines in third-party benchmarks: 3471 tops the Codeforces table
items.summary: BenchLM's updated Codeforces leaderboard puts DeepSeek V4.1 Flash 1017 first at 3471, ahead of its own V4 Pro 0813 at 3206 (figures compiled from vendor self-reports, not independently verified). By OpenRouter traffic it is also among the most-used models in production.

items.title: Study: new FormalTCS benchmark shows LLMs can explain theory, not prove it
items.summary: The new FormalTCS benchmark (143 instances from STOC/FOCS/SODA/COLT 2025–2026 papers) shows LLMs can explain theoretical computer science in natural language, but stumble when turning it into machine-verifiable proofs: autoformalization tops out at 11.2 for the best model, vs 28.7 Pass@8 when a human supplies the formal theorem. Explanation ≠ research ability.
